1. Read .gnhf/runs/fix-any-usability-pr-5460d8/notes.md first to understand what has been done in previous iterations. Do NOT write to or modify notes.md - it is maintained automatically by the gnhf orchestrator

## Output

- success: whether you were able to make a meaningful contribution that got us closer towards the objective. setting this to false means any code change you made should be discarded. A complete no-op iteration (no file changes AND no new meaningful learnings worth recording) is not a success - set success=false so the run can halt rather than spin on no-op iterations
- summary: a concise one-sentence summary of the accomplishment in this iteration
- key_changes_made: an array of descriptions for key changes you made. don't group this by file - group by logical units of work. don't describe activities - describe material outcomes
- key_learnings: an array of new learnings that were surprising, weren't captured by previous notes and would be informative for future iterations

## Objective

fix any usability problem including UI problems, user-friendliness, design, for both desktop and mobile, keep the design simple and minimalistic and avoid a bar from overflowing to a next row, causing layout shifts. User who have no knowledge about trajectory simplification should be able to use every feature of the UI without problem. If needed, a short tutorial with popover over the UI can be launched at the start (of course only when user first visit the site. Also configure the CI/CD to automatically deploy the site on gcloud. Some existijng work already exists at gnhf/check-if-there-is-an-db7a4a, may start from there but rebase on main first.
